A.objective: Using only authoritative data-room sources, determine which represented billed revenue is associated with counterparties whose active contracts contain acquisition-relevant conditions; report each qualifying invoice with counterparty and contract identifiers as they appear in sources, including amount, currency, period, and invoice status.

universe_scope.source_constraint: authoritative files in this data room only
entities_in_scope: counterparties named on invoices or contracts
contractual clauses bearing on change of control or assignment
universe_scope.world_true_boundary: Invoice fields, contract identifiers, counterparty names as recorded, contract text, and invoice status are world-observable facts. Whether a clause is acquisition-relevant, whether a contract is active for this purpose, and whether an invoice is associated with a contract are purpose-interpreted judgments over those facts.

purpose_policy: acquisition_relevant_condition: contractual term requiring consent or notice on change of control
acquisition_relevant_condition: contractual term permitting termination upon change of control
acquisition_relevant_condition: contractual term requiring consent or notice before assignment, including assignment restricted except to affiliates or prohibited to a competitor
active_contract_for_purpose_a: contract that is not an expired statement of work

qualifying_invoice: represented billed revenue whose counterparty has an active contract containing at least one acquisition-relevant condition and for which invoice-to-contract association is asserted or explicitly unresolved
world_true: invoice_id, billed_name, amount, currency, period, status as recorded in billing sources
contract_id and counterparty identifiers as they appear in contract sources
presence and verbatim text of contractual clauses in source documents
contract type and dates (e.g. SOW expiry) as recorded in sources
output_disposition: association asserted: billed name and contract counterparty confidently associated for this invoice
association unresolved: billed name and contract counterparty cannot be confidently associated

epistemic_requirements.positive_assertion_bar: Report association as asserted only when billed name and contract counterparty can be confidently associated.
epistemic_requirements.negative_inference_ban: Do not treat missing identity or missing join evidence as a negative contractual finding.
epistemic_requirements.omission_ban: Do not omit an invoice merely because association is unresolved; report it with association unresolved.
epistemic_requirements.identifier_fidelity: Report contract and counterparty identifiers exactly as they appear in authoritative sources.
epistemic_requirements.grounding_expectation: Every asserted association and every acquisition-relevant condition attribution must be traceable to source evidence; unresolved rows must state the unresolved join, not silent absence.

allowed_unresolved_states: invoice_to_contract_association: billed name cannot be confidently linked to a contract counterparty
invoice_included_with_association_unresolved: qualifying revenue row present but join to governing contract remains open

completeness_expectations.row_coverage: Every represented billed revenue invoice that qualifies under purpose policies (active contract with acquisition-relevant condition) must appear in output, whether association is asserted or unresolved.
completeness_expectations.field_coverage: Each output invoice must include invoice_id, billed_name, amount, currency, period, status, contract_id, and association.
completeness_expectations.exhaustion_note: Completeness is over represented billed revenue subject to purpose A inclusion policy, not over all possible counterparty-contract pairings in the data room.

purpose_specific_policies.active_contract_rule: An expired statement of work is not an active contract for this purpose.
purpose_specific_policies.inclusion_threshold: Include invoice when its counterparty has an active contract containing at least one acquisition-relevant condition.

association_mapping.unresolved: confident join not established; not equivalent to denial of exposure

non_goals: Do not globally reconcile counterparty identity beyond what is needed for this invoice-contract association judgment.

B.objective: Using only authoritative data-room sources, identify represented customer and commercial identities across CRM, billing, the company registry, and contracts; for each commercially relevant name or record, report whether it can be confidently treated as the same legal counterparty as other records or whether identification remains unresolved.

universe_scope.source_constraint: authoritative files in this data room only
entities_in_scope: commercially relevant names and records across the four systems above
universe_scope.world_true_boundary: Existence of CRM rows, billed names, registry company numbers, and contract filenames are world-observable. Whether two records denote the same legal counterparty is a semantic judgment that may remain unresolved; mechanical legal-form variants of a registered name are world-adjacent normalization, but same-entity vs distinct vs unresolved dispositions are epistemic outputs.

required_output_shape.ordering: sort links by left ascending, then right ascending

purpose_policy: commercially_relevant_record: name or record that must participate in cross-system identity linkage for diligence
required_link: link needed to connect a CRM account, its billed name, the contract governing that relationship, and any registry row that is a candidate legal entity for that relationship
mechanical_legal_form_variant: exact legal-form variant of the same registered name may be treated as mechanical normalization
similar_trade_name_distinct: distinct registry entities with similar trade names are not automatically the same party
world_true: crm_account_id, billed_name, company_number, contract filename as recorded in sources
registered legal names and trade names as recorded in registry and other sources
explicit co-occurrence or reference relationships in source documents where mechanically extractable
output_disposition: SAME_ENTITY: confident positive judgment that left and right denote the same legal counterparty
DISTINCT: confident positive judgment that left and right denote different legal counterparties
UNRESOLVED: identification cannot be confidently resolved either way

epistemic_requirements.positive_assertion_bar: SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not mere name compatibility or similarity.
epistemic_requirements.negative_inference_ban: Missing a positive same-entity judgment is not a negative judgment; absence of SAME_ENTITY must not be silently treated as DISTINCT.
epistemic_requirements.merge_restriction: Do not globally merge records merely because two names look similar.
epistemic_requirements.mechanical_exception: Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be resolved mechanically where sources support it.
epistemic_requirements.grounding_expectation: SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT links must be grounded in bounded evidence packets; UNRESOLVED links must explicitly record the open identification question.

allowed_unresolved_states: identity_link_UNRESOLVED: two records cannot be confidently judged same or distinct legal counterparty
registry_candidate_ambiguous: multiple or no registry rows plausibly match a commercial relationship
cross_system_join_open: required CRM-billing-contract-registry chain cannot be fully closed with confidence

completeness_expectations.link_coverage: Include every link required to connect a CRM account, its billed name, the contract governing that relationship, and any registry row that is a candidate legal entity for that relationship.
completeness_expectations.field_coverage: Each link must include left, right, and epistemic disposition.
completeness_expectations.exhaustion_note: Completeness is over required identity links for commercially relevant relationships, not over all pairwise combinations of names in the data room.

purpose_specific_policies.similarity_policy: Name similarity alone is insufficient for SAME_ENTITY; similar trade names across distinct registry entities default to unresolved or distinct, not automatic merge.
purpose_specific_policies.symmetry_expectation: Identity judgments are symmetric in meaning; output links should be oriented consistently per sort order without changing epistemic content.
non_goals: Do not perform global entity resolution or deduplication beyond required links.

C.objective: Using only authoritative data-room sources, compute a commercial dependency view: identify counterparties that are commercially dependent under stated criteria, reporting contract, open invoices, obligation kinds, and dependency status.

universe_scope.source_constraint: authoritative files in this data room only
entities_in_scope: contractual obligations of kinds exclusivity, auto-renewal, and rolling term
universe_scope.world_true_boundary: Invoice open/closed status, contract text, renewal and term clauses, and exclusivity language are world-observable. Whether a counterparty is commercially dependent is a purpose-defined composite judgment over current-relationship policy and obligation-kind policy.

purpose_policy: current_commercial_relationship: open invoice exists OR active contract auto-renews or continues on a rolling term
active_contract_for_purpose_c: contract that is not expired
commercially_dependent: both current_commercial_relationship AND at least one obligation kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term} present in the active contract
not_dependent_by_policy: expired contract alone; one-off paid historical invoice without an active contract
world_true: invoice status (open vs not open) as recorded in billing sources
contract expiry and term/renewal/exclusivity clause text as recorded in contract sources
counterparty and contract identifiers as recorded in sources
output_disposition: status dependent: counterparty meets both prongs of commercial-dependency policy with resolvable identity joins
status unresolved: dependency cannot be affirmed or denied because identity needed to join invoice and contract is unresolved

epistemic_requirements.positive_assertion_bar: Report status dependent only when both current-relationship and obligation-kind policy prongs are satisfied and invoice-contract identity joins are sufficiently resolved.
epistemic_requirements.negative_inference_ban: If identity needed to join invoice and contract is unresolved, report dependency as unresolved rather than false.
epistemic_requirements.identity_dependency: Counterparty identification must use the same identifier forms as Purpose B; unresolved identity from B propagates as unresolved dependency here.
epistemic_requirements.grounding_expectation: Each dependent row must cite the contract, qualifying obligation kinds, and supporting open invoices; unresolved rows must state that join or identity prevented a dependent/false classification.

allowed_unresolved_states: dependency_unresolved: identity or invoice-contract join insufficient to determine commercial dependency
obligation_kind_ambiguous: contract text does not confidently support exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term classification
current_relationship_ambiguous: cannot confidently determine whether a current commercial relationship exists under policy

completeness_expectations.row_coverage: Report a dependency row for each counterparty-contract combination that is a candidate under purpose C policy (active or open-invoice-backed commercial relationship with potential obligation kinds), with status dependent or unresolved.
completeness_expectations.field_coverage: Each row must include counterparty, contract_id, open_invoice_ids, obligation_kinds, and status.
completeness_expectations.exhaustion_note: Completeness is over candidate commercial dependencies implied by sources, not over all possible counterparty-contract pairs.

dependency_test.prong_1_current_relationship: open invoice OR active contract that auto-renews or continues on a rolling term
dependency_test.prong_2_obligation: active contract contains exclusivity commitment, term auto-renewal, or rolling term continuing unless notice is given
dependency_test.conjunction: both prongs required for status dependent

exclusions: Expired contracts do not create current dependency.
A one-off paid historical invoice without an active contract does not create current dependency.
purpose_specific_policies.identifier_forms: Reuse Purpose B forms: crm:, billing:, registry:, contract:
purpose_specific_policies.unresolved_over_false: Unresolved identity or join yields status unresolved, not implicit non-dependency.
non_goals: Do not re-derive full identity reconciliation; consume or align with Purpose B identifier discipline.
